```
{
  "name": "Walk the Dog?",
  "description": "A traffic light showing whether outdoor conditions are suitable for a dog walk, with an estimated walk duration based on temperature, rain chance, air quality and dog size.",
  "size": [12, 8, 6, 4],
  "every": 900,
  "taps": false,
  "feeds": ["wx", "aqi"],
  "hosts": [],
  "settings": {
    "dogSize": {
      "type": "choice",
      "label": "Dog size",
      "choices": ["Small", "Medium", "Large"],
      "default": "Medium"
    }
  }
}
```


```
Tile("dog-walk", {
  render(el) {
    const weather = this.feed("weather");
    const air = this.feed("air");
    const size = String(this.s.dogSize || "Medium").toLowerCase();
    // Schema: github.com/kizit/countertop/blob/main/tools/dash/screen.js
    const temp = weather && weather.current ? weather.current.temperature_2m : NaN;
    const aqi = typeof air === "number" ? air : NaN;
    const status = Number.isFinite(temp) && Number.isFinite(aqi) ? (aqi > 100 ? "red" : "green") : "unknown";
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dw-root dw-${status}">
        <div class="dw-heading">Walk the dog?</div>
        <div class="dw-metrics">${this.esc(size)} ${Number.isFinite(temp) ? Math.round(temp) : ""}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  },

  css: `
    .dw-root { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100%; color:var(--fg); }
    .dw-green { --signal: #42db87; }
  `
});
```
